title: The upper triangular closed subgroup scheme of the general linear group
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $n\geq1$. In the coordinate Hopf algebra $k[\operatorname{GL}_{n,k}]$ of the general linear group [def-sc-general-linear-group], let $I_n$ be the ideal generated by $x_{ij}$ for $i>j$. This is a Hopf ideal. Define the upper triangular group scheme $B_n=\operatorname{Spec}(k[\operatorname{GL}_{n,k}]/I_n)$, with the quotient Hopf group structure [def-sc-group-scheme] and canonical closed group-scheme immersion $B_n\hookrightarrow\operatorname{GL}_{n,k}$ [def-weil-closed-immersion]. The quotient spectrum is as in [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient] and [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. For every commutative $k$-algebra $A$, the inclusion identifies $B_n(A)$ with exactly the invertible matrices $g$ whose entries $g_{ij}$ vanish whenever $i>j$. This description uses every algebra, including nonreduced algebras.
